info.name: XFlight Backend
info.description: Postman collection for XFlight backend endpoints.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login to obtain JWT and generate short-lived WS tokens.

request.description: Returns JWT token. Username can be username or email.
Returns short-lived WS token. Use either Authorization or X-Device-Token.
Create default user using static key. Returns 409 if already exists.

item.name: Users
item.description: User management endpoints (requires auth).

request.description: Create new user. Requires auth (JWT or device token).
List users with pagination helpers (total_pages, has_next, has_prev, next_page, prev_page).
Update current user's profile. JWT only (device token not supported). Send only fields to update; empty string clears dob/phone/pilot_cert.
Get current user's profile. JWT only (device token not supported).
Change current user's password. JWT only (device token not supported).

item.name: UAVs
item.description: UAV management endpoints (requires auth).

request.description: Create a new UAV.
Assign (claim) a UAV to the authenticated user by serial_number.
List UAVs with pagination helpers (total_pages, has_next, has_prev, next_page, prev_page).
List UAVs assigned to the authenticated user with pagination helpers (total_pages, has_next, has_prev, next_page, prev_page).

item.name: Get My UAVs (Dropdown)
item.description: List current user's UAVs for dropdown. Each item returns id, name, camera_spec, and optional primary_docking (id, name, location_name, latitude, longitude) resolved from the primary active docking.

item.name: Get UAV By ID
item.description: Get UAV detail including latest status and dockings (with docking_status if available).

request.description: Update UAV fields (partial update).

item.name: Upload UAV Image
item.description: Upload UAV image. Automatically updates image_url.

request.description: Soft delete UAV by id.

item.name: Docking
item.description: Docking management endpoints (requires auth).

item.name: Create Docking
item.description: Create a docking record for a UAV. Only owner JWT is allowed.

item.name: Update Docking
item.description: Update docking fields. `uav_id` cannot be updated.

item.name: Delete Docking
item.description: Delete a docking record by ID.

item.name: Device Tokens
item.description: Generate per-device tokens (requires owner JWT). Tokens are returned once.

item.name: Create UAV Device Token
item.description: Create a device token scoped to a UAV. Returns token once (replaces previous token).

item.name: Create Docking Device Token
item.description: Create a device token scoped to a docking. Returns token once (replaces previous token).

item.name: Get Device Context
item.description: Returns the identity derived from X-Device-Token. Use this as a startup/bootstrap call so device services can discover scope_type, docking_id, and resolved_uav_id without hardcoding IDs.

item.name: Missions
item.description: Mission CRUD and queries.

item.name: My Missions (Paginated)
item.description: Returns missions for the authenticated user (paginated). Optional `uav_id` filter and optional exact `date` filter (`YYYY-MM-DD`, matched against the schedule date prefix). Includes waypoint_count and uav details; waypoints are not returned.

item.name: Get Mission By ID
item.description: Returns one mission by ID, including its full waypoint list.

item.name: Update Mission
item.description: Updates a mission. Send only fields to change. If `waypoints` is provided, all existing waypoints are replaced. Rejected with 409 if the mission has an active run.

item.name: Delete Mission
item.description: Soft-deletes a mission. Rejected with 409 if the mission has an active run.

request.description: Creates mission for the authenticated user. user_id is inferred from JWT. Recurring missions may include `recurrence_unit` (`hour` or `day`) and `recurrence_interval` (> 0). If `is_recurring=true` and those fields are omitted, the backend falls back to daily recurrence every 1 day.

item.name: Get Waiting Mission (Docking / Device)
item.description: Returns the nearest upcoming mission with status Waiting for the authenticated device. The backend derives the UAV from X-Device-Token (UAV token directly, docking token via docking->UAV mapping). Mission responses also include optional recurrence_unit and recurrence_interval.

item.name: Get SafeToFly Mission (Drone / Device)
item.description: Returns the active mission run whose runtime status is SafeToFly for the authenticated device. The backend derives the UAV from X-Device-Token. Response keeps the same mission fields and waypoint list as the next-mission flow, plus history_id and runtime_status.

item.name: Get Current Mission (Device)
item.description: Returns the current active mission_history for the authenticated device token, regardless of runtime state. Response includes has_active_mission and, when active, mission_id, history_id, mission_history_id, and status.

request.description: Starts a mission run and returns history_id. The new mission_history row begins at status PreparingDock.

item.name: Mission History
item.description: Mission run lifecycle and history listings.

request.description: List mission history entries for the authenticated user with pagination helpers (total_pages, has_next, has_prev, next_page, prev_page). Optional `mission_id` to filter by mission. Each item also includes `media_count` so the client can show the number of uploaded files for that run.
Lists media files attached to one mission run. Optional `event_id` filters media attached to one mission_event.

item.name: List Mission Events
item.description: Lists the event timeline for one mission run, including from_state, to_state, result, failure_code, message, is_terminal, and created_at.

item.name: Get Mission State
item.description: Returns the latest persisted runtime state for one mission run, including status, terminal flag, failure details, completed_at, and last_event_at.

request.description: Uploads one or more image/video files to a mission run. Use repeated `files` fields for multi-file upload. Optional `event_id` links the files to a specific mission_event.

Updates the runtime state of a mission run. Valid normal flow: PreparingDock -> SafeToFly -> Takeoff -> DockConfirmed, with optional Takeoff -> InFlight -> DockConfirmed when the drone still has connectivity. Any non-terminal state may also move to Failed or Aborted.

Completes a mission run using history_id from /missions/{id}/start. This endpoint expects the current mission_history status to be DockConfirmed. For recurring missions, the backend sets mission_status back to Waiting and recalculates the next schedule using recurrence_unit/recurrence_interval.

item.name: Telemetry
item.description: Mission telemetry batch storage and retrieval.

item.name: Realtime
item.description: Realtime telemetry ingestion and WS connection.

item.name: Update UAV Status
item.description: Upsert UAV status via realtime ingestion (kind=status, metric=uav_status). Requires UAV device token or owner JWT.

item.name: Update Docking Status
item.description: Upsert docking status via realtime ingestion (kind=status, metric=docking_status). Requires docking device token; optionally include `docking_id` if using UAV token/JWT. If your docking service still needs IDs locally, call GET /device-context once at startup and reuse the returned docking_id / resolved_uav_id.

request.description: Connect with ws:// and a valid wsToken from /auth/ws-token. After connect, send {"type":"subscribe","uav_ids":[{{uavId}}]} to receive updates, or {"type":"publish","uav_id":{{uavId}},"kind":"telemetry","metric":"battery","payload":{"percent":78.2}} to publish telemetry directly over the same socket.

item.name: Assets
item.description: Locations and media uploads.

item.name: Get Footage File
item.description: Fetch uploaded media by filename without auth. Use `public_path` from upload/list responses and strip the leading `/footages/` into `{{footageFile}}`.

item.name: Download Mission Media
item.description: Download one uploaded mission media file as an attachment without auth. Use `download_path` from upload/list responses or provide `mediaId` directly.
